x: With 30 yards to go he was still leading but Harrison (Cheshire) and Rodwell (Glos) had drawn level. Harrison moved ahead to win in 22.0 and Rodwell pipped Steve on the tape 22.1 to 22.2.
He smashed his own club record with 3.36.28 only for a peak form Harrison to rob him of the title in the home straight. Gary took 5th in 3.45.01 while Stuart Paton had run 3.51.52 in the heats.

John Gladwin needed to avenge that 'UK' defeat by Harrison, and win, to be sure of a Commonwealth spot, while Gary Staines, with a new pb from the week before, could also look for a prominent showing.
